Created 3 pytest test files in crucible_hidden/ for milestones m1-m3:

- test_m1.py (4 tests): Verifies memoize wrapper exposes .skip (SkipMemoization), .invalidate(*args, **kwargs), and .invalidate_all() methods. All fail because these attributes don't exist on the current memoize wrapper.

- test_m2.py (4 tests): Verifies cache wrapper exposes .memory (live dict) and .skip (unified with memoize's SkipMemoization). Also checks memory entry structure is (result, datetime) tuple. All fail because cache doesn't expose these attributes.

- test_m3.py (3 tests): Verifies @reraise accepts callable `into` parameter that receives caught exception and returns new exception to raise. Tests both decorator and context manager forms. All fail because current reraise uses raise_from(into, e) which fails when into is callable.

All 11 tests fail/error as expected since the features are not yet implemented.
